services.name: Castle Peak Yurt
services.desc: Inspired Summit Adventures is thrilled to share our new hut to hut guided and catered trips. The Hut to Hut first opened last season (2024-25) with our guides pioneering multiple routes and serving up exceptional trips for each of our clients. The Hut to Hut has quickly became a client favorite! During this multi day trip you and your group will start at the Castle Peak Yurt. There you will get a lay of the land, go for some upper elevation ski tours and enjoy the wood burning sauna. Half way through your trip you will leave your overnight gear behind for our team to transfer for you while you head deeper into the Uintas.
